changelog: Say "new line" — or "নতুন লাইন" in Bengali — alone while dictating in WhatsApp or Messenger and a line break is inserted, so a long message can have paragraphs without reaching for the enter key. "New paragraph" / "নতুন অনুচ্ছেদ" inserts a blank line, and "enter" / "next line" / "পরের লাইন" work too. Gboard documents the same commands, but this keyboard only had them behind the spoken-punctuation toggle, which is off by default — until now saying it alone typed the literal words "new line" into the message. The next word after the break is capitalized like a sentence start, and the break can be undone or cleared like any dictated text. Saying the phrase inside a longer sentence still types it as normal text.
